entries.en: 1. Our commitment to trust and transparency
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
Your rights come from the law, not from our goodwill. This page sets them out in one place, alongside the promises Karmicare adds on top.

At KARMICARE, we believe in radical transparency, both in the biological formulations we craft and in the commercial relationships we build with our community. This charter summarises your statutory rights under:

  • The Belgian Code of Economic Law (WER/CDE), notably Book VI on market practices and consumer protection;
  • The EU Consumer Rights Directive (2011/83/EU);
  • The EU Omnibus Directive (2019/2161) on modernised consumer protection rules;
  • The EU Sale of Goods Directive (2019/771), transposed into Belgian law by the Law of 20 March 2022;
  • The EU Cosmetics Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009.

Whether you try a single duo or become a member, your legal rights are fully protected.

entries.en: 2. EU cosmetic safety and standards
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
Awake and Asleep are notified EU cosmetics, made under Good Manufacturing Practice and assessed by a qualified safety assessor.

All KARMICARE products, including Awake Morning Toothpaste, Asleep Evening Toothpaste, Charcoal Floss and the Toothbrushes, are:

  • Formulated and manufactured in accordance with European Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP / ISO 22716);
  • Registered and notified on the European Cosmetic Product Notification Portal (CPNP) in compliance with Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009;
  • Subject to a Cosmetic Product Safety Report (CPSR) signed by a qualified European safety assessor;
  • 100% free of SLS, parabens, artificial dyes, endocrine disruptors and controversial abrasives.

Regulatory classification: KARMICARE oral care products are cosmetics intended for daily oral hygiene, biorhythmic remineralisation and enamel support. They are not medicinal products or medical devices and do not claim to diagnose, treat or cure medical conditions.

entries.en: 3. Refunds, withdrawal and money-back guarantees
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
Every first order comes with a money-back guarantee: 14 days on Try Once, your first cycle on the 60-Day rhythm, 60 days on the Year. Your legal right to withdraw comes on top.

3.1 Your legal right to withdraw (14 days)

  • You can withdraw from an online order within 14 calendar days of delivery, without giving a reason (Article VI.47 of the Belgian Code of Economic Law). For a membership, the 14 days run from your first delivery. Tell us by email at care@karmicare.com, by phone on +32 (0) 478 57 27 61, or with the form in section 10.
  • We reimburse all payments received from you, including standard delivery charges, within 14 calendar days of receiving the returned unopened goods or proof of return.
  • This right comes from the law. Our money-back guarantees below come on top of it and never limit it.

3.2 Try Once: 14-day money-back guarantee

  • Not convinced? Tell us within 14 days of delivery and we refund everything you paid, including shipping.
  • You may open and try the duo, and keep it. Nothing has to be sent back.

3.3 60-Day rhythm: your first cycle

  • The guarantee covers your first 60-day cycle. Tell us before your first renewal (60 days after your order) and we refund your first payment.
  • Care Credit you already spent from that payment is deducted; unused credit from it is removed.
  • You keep the duo and the Welcome Kit. Your membership ends and nothing renews.
  • We remind you 5 days before your first renewal. Continuing into your second cycle ends the guarantee.

3.4 Year: 60 days from your first delivery

  • Tell us within 60 days of your first delivery and we refund your annual payment, minus any Care Credit you already spent from it. Unused credit from it is removed, and your remaining deliveries are cancelled.
  • You keep the opened duo and the Welcome Kit. Send the other duos back unopened (pump never primed) within 14 days, with the prepaid label we send you.
  • For each extra duo that comes back opened, or does not come back, €59 is deducted. If the return parcel gets lost, you still get your refund once the carrier’s tracking shows it was handed in.

3.5 One money-back guarantee per customer

Each customer has one money-back guarantee, whichever option you start with. Switching to another plan or rejoining later does not add a new one. Your legal rights are never limited by this.

3.6 How refunds work

  1. Email care@karmicare.com, or call +32 (0) 478 57 27 61, with your order number.
  2. We refund within 14 days of approving your request or, for a Year refund, of receiving your returned duos. The money always goes back to the payment method you used; we never replace a refund with a voucher unless you ask for one.
  3. If you paid partly with Care Credit, that credit returns to your balance. Care Credit is never paid out in cash.
  4. To withdraw from a one-time order under your legal right, we send you a return authorisation and the address: KARMICA BV, Returns Department, Vizierstraat 28, 8000 Bruges, Belgium. Return shipping is yours, unless the item arrived damaged or defective.

3.7 Packaging notice: airless pump and first-use priming

  • Hermetic airless protection. Our formulas are housed in hygienic airless pump dispensers that shield the formulation from air, oxidation and microbial contamination without relying on harsh preservatives.
  • First-use priming (3 to 10 pumps). Our pumps are not pre-pumped. On first use, press the pump head firmly 3 to 10 times to draw the formula into the nozzle.
  • Sealed delivery: the unprimed pump is the seal. Priming it opens the formula, and an opened formula cannot be returned under the legal right of withdrawal for hygiene reasons; if that rule did not apply, we could still deduct its loss of value, up to its full price. Our money-back guarantees above are more generous and are not affected.

entries.en: 4. Two-year legal guarantee of conformity
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
If something is faulty, you are covered for two years from delivery, and the law assumes the fault was there from the start.

Under Belgian law (Article 1649bis and following of the Civil Code and Book VI WER, implementing Directive (EU) 2019/771), European consumers benefit from a mandatory two-year legal guarantee of conformity on all goods purchased from KARMICARE.

4.1 Two-year presumption of conformity

  • If a delivered item is defective, non-conforming or damaged on delivery, you are protected for two full years (24 months) from the date of delivery.
  • Any defect that appears within those two years is presumed to have existed at the time of delivery, unless proven otherwise or incompatible with the nature of the goods.

4.2 Your remedies

  1. Free replacement or repair. You choose between a free replacement and a repair, provided the remedy you choose is not impossible or disproportionate.
  2. Price reduction or ending the contract. If replacement is impossible, or cannot be carried out within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience, you can ask for an appropriate price reduction or a full refund and end the contract.

4.3 Telling us about a defect

Let us know within two months of discovering a defect (Article 1649quater, §2 of the Belgian Civil Code). Email care@karmicare.com with photos or a video of the defect and your order details.

entries.en: 5. Delivery and risk in transit
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
Until your parcel is in your hands, it is our responsibility.

  • Where we deliver: to every member state of the European Union.
  • Shipping: memberships ship free. For Try Once, the shipping charge for your zone is shown at checkout before you pay.
  • Risk in transit (Art. VI.44 WER). The risk of loss, damage or theft in transit stays with KARMICARE until the parcel is handed to you or to the recipient you name.
  • Delayed deliveries. Unless we agreed another date, we deliver within 30 days. If we do not, you can give us an additional reasonable period; if we still fail to deliver, you can end the contract and receive a full refund within 14 calendar days.

Delivery times (estimates)

  • Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg: within 24 hours
  • Rest of the European Union: 2–3 working days

entries.en: 6. Your membership: renewals, pauses and cancelling
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
No lock-in. Your member price stays the same, we remind you before every renewal, and you can gift, pause or stop whenever you like.

  • Billing: the 60-Day rhythm renews every 60 days. The Year renews once a year on its anniversary, with your six duos delivered in two parts: three at the start and three after six months.
  • Renewal reminder: we email you 5 days before every 60-Day rhythm renewal, and 30 days and 7 days before every Year renewal, so you have time to pause, reschedule, skip or cancel.
  • Pausing: pause for up to 60 days at a time, and for up to 60 days in total within any 12 months. On the Year, you can postpone your second delivery by up to 60 days; your renewal date stays the same.
  • Cancelling: cancel at any time in your customer portal. Cancelling stops your next renewal; it is not a refund request, so deliveries you already paid for still arrive. Refunds follow section 3.
  • Renewals: renewal orders are dispatched two working days after the charge; cancel before dispatch and we refund the renewal in full. After a Year has renewed, you can end it at any time with one month’s notice, and we refund €59 for every duo not yet dispatched.
  • Gifting: send a delivery as a gift to another address in the EU from your customer portal. Your membership, Care Credit and guarantee stay with you.
  • Price protection: your member price stays the same for as long as you stay a member, also during a pause, even if our prices rise.
  • Care Credit: members earn 10% (60-Day rhythm) or 20% (Year) of every membership payment as Care Credit, to spend on any order. The full rules are in our Terms and Conditions.

entries.en: 7. Pricing transparency
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
The price you see includes VAT. A “was” price is always our lowest price of the previous 30 days, and every review comes from a verified order.

In accordance with the EU Omnibus Directive (2019/2161) and the Belgian Code of Economic Law (Art. VI.19/1 WER):

  • All-inclusive pricing. Prices shown to European consumers include VAT and all applicable levies. Shipping costs are shown before final checkout.
  • Genuine discounts. When we announce a price reduction, the reference price is the lowest price KARMICARE applied in the preceding 30 days.
  • Authentic reviews. We only collect and publish reviews from verified purchasers. Reviews are never manipulated, selectively hidden or bought.

entries.en: 8. Complaints and dispute resolution
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
Write to us first: we reply within 2 working days and give you a solution or a substantiated answer within 7 working days. If we cannot agree, independent help is available.

Email care@karmicare.com, or call +32 (0) 478 57 27 61, about any issue with an order, a delivery or a formula. We reply within 2 working days and give a solution or substantiated answer within 7 working days. Customer care answers in English and Dutch.

If we cannot reach an amicable solution, you have access to independent out-of-court dispute resolution.

8.1 Belgian Consumer Mediation Service

For Belgian and cross-border European disputes: Consumer Mediation Service (Consumentenombudsdienst / Service de Médiation pour le Consommateur), North Gate II, Boulevard du Roi Albert II 8, box 1, 1000 Brussels, Belgium · Tel. +32 2 702 52 00 · contact@consumentenombudsdienst.be · consumerombudsman.be/en

8.2 European Consumer Centre

For a dispute across EU borders, the European Consumer Centre in your country can help. In Belgium: European Consumer Centre Belgium, Koning Albert II-laan 16, 1000 Brussels · Tel. +32 2 277 99 00 · info@eccbelgium.be · eccbe.eu

The EU Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) platform closed on 20 July 2025, so it is no longer a route for complaints.

entries.en: 9. Applicable law and jurisdiction
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
Belgian law applies, but never at the expense of the protection your own country gives you.

Contracts concluded with KARMICARE are governed by Belgian law. Under Article 6 of the Rome I Regulation (EC) No 593/2008, consumers residing in the European Union also keep the mandatory protection of the consumer laws of their country of habitual residence.

Under Article 18 of the Brussels I bis Regulation (EU) No 1215/2012, you can bring a claim before the competent courts of the place where you live.

entries.en:
This policy explains what we collect about you, why we need it, who helps us process it, and how you stay in control.

KARMICA BV (“KARMICARE”, “we”, “us” or “our”) respects your fundamental right to privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data in full compliance with:

  • The General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (“GDPR”);
  • The Belgian Data Protection Act of 30 July 2018;
  • The Belgian Electronic Communications Act of 13 June 2005, transposing the ePrivacy Directive 2002/58/EC as amended;

This policy explains how we collect, process, store, disclose and safeguard your personal data when you visit our website, order from us, start a plan or contact our customer care.

entries.en: 3. Personal data we process
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
We collect what we need to deliver your order, run your membership and answer your questions. Oral-health data only for the Dental Check-up Reward, and only with your explicit consent.

Depending on how you interact with KARMICARE, we process the following categories of personal data:

  • Identification and contact data: first name, last name, billing and delivery address, email address, telephone number, and company name or VAT number (for B2B dental partners).
  • Transaction and order data: what you ordered, your membership (Awake and Asleep frequency, interval, delivery cycle), order history, payment reference IDs, carrier, order notes and return or refund records. Full card numbers are processed by our PCI-DSS Level 1 payment providers, Stripe and PayPal, and are never stored on our servers.
  • Account and membership data: customer portal login, delivery schedule preferences, pauses and skipped deliveries, and membership status (active, paused, cancelled), and the name and address of anyone you send a delivery to as a gift.
  • Care Credit data: your Care Credit balance, the credit you earn and spend, and your reward status.
  • Check-up data (Year members, only with your explicit consent): your answers to the starting and follow-up questionnaires about your oral health, and proof of your dental visit (an appointment confirmation or invoice).
  • Communication data: records of your messages by email or contact form, including product questions, after-sales questions and feedback.
  • Marketing and newsletter data: email address, first name, communication preferences, newsletter status, open and click events, and discount or voucher use.
  • Technical, navigation and cookie data: IP address (anonymised where applicable), browser and version, device identifier, operating system, referral source, pages viewed, time per page, language, Day/Night preference and cart token.

Your questionnaire answers about your oral health are health data, a special category of personal data (Article 9 GDPR). We process them only with your explicit consent, only for the Dental Check-up Reward and the follow-up of your oral health, and you can withdraw that consent at any time. We do not process other special categories of personal data, such as racial or ethnic origin, genetic or biometric data. Our formulas are notified EU cosmetics, not medicinal treatments.

entries.en: 6. International data transfers
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
When your data leaves the European Economic Area, it travels under an EU-approved safeguard.

When personal data is transferred outside the European Economic Area (EEA), in particular to the United States, KARMICARE ensures an adequate level of protection in line with Articles 44–49 GDPR:

  1. Adequacy decisions: transfers to countries the European Commission recognises as adequate, such as Canada for commercial organisations under PIPEDA.
  2. EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (DPF): where US providers (such as Shopify, Google, Meta, Klaviyo, Stripe and Webflow) are certified under the DPF.
  3. Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs): where providers are not DPF-certified, transfers follow the Commission’s Standard Contractual Clauses (Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/914), with transfer impact assessments and encryption safeguards.

You can ask for a copy of the relevant safeguards at care@karmicare.com.

entries.en: 7. How long we keep your data
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
We keep your data only as long as the purpose or the law requires, then delete or anonymise it.

We store personal data only as long as necessary for the purpose it was collected for, or to meet legal retention duties:

  • Order, invoicing and accounting records: kept for 7 years after the end of the financial year (Art. III.86 WER and Art. 315 CIR92).
  • Membership and Care Credit records: kept while your membership is active, then 7 years after it ends, for tax and limitation purposes.
  • Check-up questionnaires and visit proof: proof of your dental visit is deleted 60 days after we have checked it; we keep only the date it was verified. Your questionnaire answers are kept while your membership continues and for 24 months after it ends, so your oral-health history is still there if you return. If you withdraw your consent, we delete them straight away.
  • Customer care messages: kept for 2 years after resolution, to handle legal guarantee claims and disputes.
  • Newsletter and marketing data: kept until you withdraw consent or unsubscribe. After 24 months of inactivity, your data is removed or archived.
  • Analytics and cookie data: kept for at most 13 months, then deleted or permanently anonymised.

entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en: 8. Your rights under the GDPR
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
You can see, correct, delete, move or limit your data, and object to marketing at any time. We answer within one month.

As a data subject, you have the following rights:

  1. Access (Art. 15): ask whether we process your data and receive a free copy of it.
  2. Rectification (Art. 16): have inaccurate data corrected or incomplete data completed.
  3. Erasure (Art. 17): have your data deleted when it is no longer needed, when you withdraw consent or when processing is unlawful, subject to legal retention duties (for example the Belgian 7-year accounting rules).
  4. Restriction (Art. 18): have processing frozen while the accuracy or lawfulness of the data is contested.
  5. Portability (Art. 20): receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format (JSON, CSV) and have it transferred to another provider.
  6. Objection (Art. 21): object at any time, without giving a reason, to direct marketing, and object to processing based on legitimate interests on grounds relating to your situation.
  7. Withdrawing consent (Art. 7(3)): withdraw consent for newsletters, marketing cookies or the check-up questionnaires at any time, without affecting earlier processing.
  8. No automated decisions (Art. 22): KARMICARE does not use automated decision-making or profiling that produces legal effects for you.

How to exercise your rights

Email care@karmicare.com or write to KARMICA BV — Privacy Operations, Vizierstraat 28, 8000 Bruges, Belgium.

We respond without undue delay and at the latest within one month of receipt. Where necessary, given the complexity and number of requests, this can be extended by two further months; we then tell you within the first month.

Your right to complain

If you believe our processing breaks data protection law, you can lodge a complaint with the Belgian Data Protection Authority or with the supervisory authority in your country:

Belgian Data Protection Authority (Gegevensbeschermingsautoriteit / Autorité de protection des données), Drukpersstraat 35, 1000 Brussels, Belgium · Tel. +32 2 274 48 00 · contact@apd-gba.be · gegevensbeschermingsautoriteit.be

entries.en: 9. Cookies and tracking
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
Essential cookies keep the shop working. Everything else waits for your consent, and you can change your mind at any time.

Our website uses cookies and similar technologies (local storage, session tokens, pixel tags) to make the site work, remember your preferences and, with your consent, measure traffic and show relevant advertising.

9.1 Cookie categories

  • Strictly necessary: core operation of the shop, security, sessions, cart and checkout. These need no consent and cannot be switched off (Art. 5(3) ePrivacy Directive exemption).
  • Functional: remember your language (en, nl, fr), country and Day/Night preference.
  • Performance and analytics: measure traffic, referrers and site performance (for example Google Analytics 4, Hotjar). Active only after your explicit consent.
  • Marketing and advertising: set by advertising partners (for example Meta Pixel, TriplePixel, Klaviyo) to track visits across websites and build interest profiles for targeted ads. Active only after your explicit consent.

9.2 Your consent choices

On your first visit, our consent banner lets you accept all cookies, decline all non-essential cookies, or choose by category.

No non-essential cookies or tracking scripts run before you opt in. You can change or withdraw your choice at any time through the “Cookie settings” link in our footer.

entries.en: 10. Data security
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
Your data travels encrypted, and only the people who need it can reach it.

KARMICA BV uses technical and organisational measures to protect personal data against accidental loss, unauthorised access, destruction, misuse or alteration:

  • TLS encryption for all web traffic and data transfers;
  • role-based access controls and multi-factor authentication (MFA) for administrative systems;
  • anonymisation and pseudonymisation of analytics data;
  • regular system audits, automatic security patching and vulnerability management;
  • data processing agreements with every sub-processor, requiring confidentiality and GDPR compliance.

entries.en: Clause 4 – Withdrawal, money-back guarantees and refunds
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
Every first order comes with a money-back guarantee: 14 days on Try Once, your first cycle on the 60-Day rhythm, 60 days on the Year. Your legal right to withdraw comes on top.

4.1 Statutory right of withdrawal (14 days)

  1. 14-day withdrawal period: you may withdraw from a contract concluded online without giving a reason within 14 calendar days of physical delivery (Article VI.47 WER). For a membership, the period runs from your first delivery. Tell us by email at care@karmicare.com, by phone on +32 (0) 478 57 27 61, or with the form in the Annex.
  2. Reimbursement: we reimburse all payments received from you, including standard delivery charges, within 14 calendar days of receiving the returned unopened goods or proof of return shipment.
  3. Same payment method: we reimburse via the same payment method you used. We never substitute a voucher unless you expressly ask for one.
  4. Relation to our guarantees: the money-back guarantees in clauses 4.2 to 4.5 are voluntary commercial guarantees. They come on top of your statutory rights and never limit them.

4.2 Try Once: 14-day money-back guarantee

  1. Period: 14 calendar days from delivery.
  2. Opened formulas qualify: you may open and try the duo and keep it. No return is required.
  3. Refund: everything you paid for the order, including the shipping charge, within 14 days of approval, to your original payment method.

4.3 60-Day rhythm: money-back guarantee for your first cycle

  1. Scope: the guarantee applies to new members and covers the first 60-day cycle only.
  2. Deadline: your request must reach us before your first renewal is charged (60 days after your order). We remind you at least 5 days before. Continuing into the second cycle ends the guarantee.
  3. Refund: your first membership payment, minus any Care Credit you already spent that was earned from that payment. Unused Care Credit earned from that payment is removed. The refund follows within 14 days of approval, to your original payment method.
  4. What you keep: the duo and the Welcome Kit. Nothing has to be returned. Your membership ends and no renewal follows.

4.4 Year: 60-day money-back guarantee

  1. Deadline: within 60 calendar days of your first delivery.
  2. Refund: your annual payment, minus any Care Credit you already spent that was earned from that payment. Unused Care Credit earned from that payment is removed, remaining deliveries are cancelled and the renewal is stopped.
  3. Return: you keep the opened duo and the Welcome Kit. The other duos come back unopened (pump never primed) within 14 days of approval, with the prepaid return label we send you at our expense.
  4. Deductions: for each additional duo that comes back opened, or does not come back, €59 is deducted from the refund.
  5. Lost return parcels: we carry the transport risk of our prepaid label. The refund is paid once the carrier’s tracking shows the parcel was handed in.
  6. Timing: the refund follows within 14 days of receiving and inspecting the returned duos, to your original payment method.

4.5 One money-back guarantee per customer

Each customer is entitled to one money-back guarantee in total, whichever option they start with (Try Once, 60-Day rhythm or Year). Switching plans or rejoining does not create a new guarantee. This rule never limits your statutory withdrawal right or your legal guarantee of conformity.

4.6 Packaging notice: airless pump and first-use priming

  1. Hermetic airless packaging: where KARMICARE formulas come in airless packaging, the pump creates a continuous vacuum that protects the active formulation from air, oxidation and bacterial contamination without harsh chemical preservatives.
  2. Unprimed factory state and priming: the pumps are not pre-pumped. On first use, press the pump head firmly 3 to 10 times to draw the formula into the nozzle.
  3. Sealed delivery and opened formulas: Awake and Asleep are delivered sealed. The pump is unprimed and the nozzle holds no formula; priming the pump breaks that seal. Once primed, a formula can no longer be sold for hygiene reasons, so the statutory right of withdrawal no longer applies to it (Art. VI.53, 5° WER). Should that exception not apply in your case, we may deduct the loss of value caused by the use from your refund, up to the full price of the formula (Art. VI.51 §2 WER). Our money-back guarantees in clauses 4.2 to 4.4 are more generous and are not affected.

4.7 How to request a refund or return

  1. Email care@karmicare.com, or call +32 (0) 478 57 27 61, with your order number and the option you chose (Try Once, 60-Day rhythm or Year).
  2. For a statutory withdrawal of a one-time order, we send you a return authorisation and the warehouse address: KARMICA BV, Returns Department, Vizierstraat 28, 8000 Bruges, Belgium. You pay the direct cost of return shipping, unless the return is due to a defect or our shipping error.
  3. All refunds are issued without deductions or administrative fees other than those set out in clause 4.4.
  4. Orders paid partly with Care Credit: the money paid goes back to your original payment method and the Care Credit you used returns to your balance. Care Credit earned from the refunded order is removed, or deducted from the refund if you already spent it. Care Credit is never paid out in cash.

entries.en: Clause 7 – Legal guarantee of conformity
entries.notes: type text; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
A faulty pump, a defective formula or a broken brush is covered for two years. Using up a formula is not a defect.

  1. Legal framework: European consumers have a legal guarantee of conformity under Articles 1649bis to 1649octies of the Belgian Civil Code and Book VI WER, transposing Directive (EU) 2019/771 (Law of 20 March 2022).
  2. Consumable oral care (nature of the goods): under Article 1649quater, §4 of the Belgian Civil Code, the guarantee applies taking into account the nature of the goods. KARMICARE formulas are consumable cosmetic goods designed for an intended cycle of daily use (for example 30 to 60 days, depending on volume and frequency). The guarantee does not mean a formula lasts two years once opened. Normal depletion, natural bristle wear, or use beyond the Period After Opening (PAO) or minimum durability date is not a lack of conformity.
  3. What is covered: latent manufacturing defects and mechanical non-conformities present at or arising from delivery: failure, jamming or breakage of the airless pump while formula remains inside under normal use; formulation defects such as premature separation, contamination, abnormal discolouration or instability before the expiry date or PAO when stored as recommended; defective seals, leaking containers or structural defects in toothbrush handles or floss dispensers.
  4. Remedies: for a verified manufacturing or packaging defect, KARMICARE provides a free replacement of the defective unit (or a replacement bottle or pump). If replacement is impossible or disproportionate, you are entitled to a proportionate price reduction, or to end the contract with a full refund.
  5. Notification: tell us within two months of discovering a lack of conformity (Art. 1649quater, §2 Belgian Civil Code) by emailing care@karmicare.com with your order number, a description, and photos or a video of the defect.
  6. Exclusions: normal depletion of the formula; natural wear of toothbrush bristles; damage from improper storage (extreme temperatures, direct sunlight, moisture or tampering with the bottle); use after the PAO or expiry date.

Examples
entries.notes: type richtext; legal text: translate faithfully and completely, keep every defined term, number, period, address and identifier; legal-review

entries.en:
Normal product depletion: excluded Example: asking for a replacement because the formula has been used up.
Why: consumable cosmetics are designed to be used up; normal exhaustion fulfils the contract.

Normal bristle wear: excluded Example: bristles splaying or softening after 2–3 months of daily brushing.
Why: routine wear and tear; dentists recommend replacing a toothbrush every 2–3 months.

Expired Period After Opening (PAO): excluded Example: a bottle opened 18 months ago dries out.
Why: stability is certified only within the indicated PAO.

Improper storage: excluded Example: a bottle left on a radiator or in a hot car separates.
Why: heat damage caused by storage against the storage guidelines.

Airless pump failure: covered Example: the piston jams or the head breaks in week 2 under normal use while formula remains inside.
Remedy: free replacement unit.

Formulation or batch defect: covered Example: curdled, separated or discoloured formula on first use.
Remedy: free replacement or full refund.

Unopened stock within shelf life: covered Example: a properly stored, unopened plan bottle goes bad before its printed expiry date.
Remedy: replacement.

Structural toothbrush or floss defect: covered Example: a handle snaps on day 4 or bristles shed on first use.
Remedy: replacement.

entries.en:
No lock-in, a protected price and a reminder before every renewal. Gift, pause, skip or stop whenever you like.

  1. The options: Try Once is a single duo without renewal. The 60-Day rhythm delivers one duo and renews every 60 days. The Year delivers six duos, three at the start and three six months later, and renews once a year on its anniversary; a Year that starts on 29 February renews on 28 February. Prices are shown at checkout.
  2. Authorisation: when you start a membership, you authorise KARMICARE (through our payment processor, Stripe) to charge your chosen payment method automatically at each renewal: every 60 days, or once a year.
  3. Welcome Kit: your first membership order includes a Welcome Kit with a morning toothbrush, an evening toothbrush and a charcoal floss.
  4. Renewal reminder: we email you at least 5 days before every 60-Day rhythm renewal, and 30 days and 7 days before every Year renewal, so you can pause, reschedule, skip or cancel in time.
  5. Pausing: you can pause for up to 60 days at a time, and for up to 60 days in total within any 12 months. On the Year, a pause postpones your second delivery by up to 60 days; your renewal date stays the same.
  6. Cancelling: you can cancel at any time in your customer portal or by email. Cancelling stops your next renewal; it is not a refund request. Deliveries you already paid for, such as the second half of a Year, still arrive. Refunds follow clause 4; for a renewed membership, see 9.9.
  7. End of your membership: your membership ends when the last period you paid for runs out.
  8. Switching plans: to move from the 60-Day rhythm to the Year, cancel your 60-Day rhythm and start a Year membership. A switch does not create a new money-back guarantee (clause 4.5).
  9. Renewal orders and ending a renewed Year: renewal orders are dispatched two working days after the charge. If you cancel before dispatch, we refund the renewal in full. After a Year has renewed, you can end it at any time with one month’s notice; we refund €59 for every duo not yet dispatched. Care Credit earned on a refunded amount is removed, or deducted if you already spent it (clause 4.7).
  10. Gifting: you can send a delivery as a gift to another address in the European Union from your customer portal. The membership, its payments, Care Credit, the right of withdrawal and the money-back guarantee stay with you; the recipient receives the formulas only.

entries.en:
Members earn Care Credit with every payment and can spend it on any order. It stays valid while you are a member, and for 12 months after.

  1. Earning: you earn Care Credit worth 10% of each 60-Day rhythm payment and 20% of each Year payment. It is available immediately after a successful payment.
  2. Other Care Credit: Year members can earn the Dental Check-up Reward as Care Credit (clause 11), and you receive €5 for completing the starting questionnaire.
  3. Spending: you can apply Care Credit to any product, including membership orders. It is deducted from that order only; it does not change your membership price or later charges.
  4. No cash value: Care Credit is never paid out in cash and cannot be transferred.
  5. Validity: Care Credit stays valid while your membership continues and for 12 months after it ends (clause 9.7). If you rejoin within those 12 months, your remaining credit carries over.
  6. Refunds: if an order is refunded, the Care Credit you used on it returns to your balance; Care Credit earned from it is removed, or deducted from the refund if you already spent it (clause 4.7).

entries.en:
Year members who have their oral health checked after six months receive €40 in Care Credit, once per membership year.

  1. Who: members of the Year, in any EU member state.
  2. When: for a dental visit from six months after your first delivery until your membership anniversary.
  3. What we need: proof of the visit (an appointment confirmation or invoice) and the follow-up questionnaire. Your answers about your oral health are processed only with your explicit consent; see our Privacy Policy.
  4. Reward: €40 in Care Credit, once per membership year.

entries.en:
If something truly beyond anyone’s control blocks the contract for more than 30 days, either of us can end it and you get your money back.

  1. Neither party is liable for delay or failure caused by force majeure (Article 5.226 of the Belgian Civil Code): an event beyond reasonable control that is unforeseeable, unavoidable and makes performance temporarily or permanently impossible (for example natural disasters, armed conflict, government restrictions, severe disruption of telecom or power networks, pandemic travel bans or general postal strikes).
  2. During force majeure, our obligations are suspended. If it lasts more than 30 consecutive days, either party may end the contract with immediate effect by written notice, and all prepaid amounts for undelivered goods are refunded within 14 calendar days without further compensation.

entries.en:
Write to us first. If we cannot agree, independent mediation is available, and the consumer law of your own country still protects you.

  1. Complaints: for questions, feedback or complaints, write to our customer care at care@karmicare.com or call +32 (0) 478 57 27 61. We reply within 2 working days and give a substantiated answer or solution within 7 working days. Customer care answers in English and Dutch.
  2. Out-of-court dispute resolution: if we cannot reach an amicable solution, European consumers can turn to independent consumer mediation: the Belgian Consumer Mediation Service (Consumentenombudsdienst / Service de Médiation pour le Consommateur), North Gate II, Boulevard du Roi Albert II 8, box 1, 1000 Brussels · Tel. +32 2 702 52 00 · contact@consumentenombudsdienst.be · consumerombudsman.be/en. For a dispute across EU borders, the European Consumer Centre in your country can help; in Belgium: European Consumer Centre Belgium, Koning Albert II-laan 16, 1000 Brussels · Tel. +32 2 277 99 00 · info@eccbelgium.be.
  3. Applicable law: all agreements between KARMICA BV and its customers are governed by Belgian law. Under Article 6 of Regulation (EC) No 593/2008 (“Rome I”), this choice does not deprive a consumer living in another EU member state of the protection of the mandatory provisions of the law of their country of habitual residence.
  4. Competent courts: for consumers domiciled in the European Union, the jurisdiction rules of the Brussels I bis Regulation (EU) No 1215/2012 apply: you may bring proceedings before the Belgian courts or the competent courts of the member state where you live. For B2B purchasers, the Enterprise Court of Ghent, division Bruges, has exclusive jurisdiction.

The EU Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) platform closed on 20 July 2025, so it is no longer a route for complaints.

entries.en: You have the right to access your Personal Data and the ways in which we use them at any time, free of charge. You have the right to request us to correct, supplement or remove your Personal Data. In a number of cases listed in the GDPR, you may also ask us to limit the processing of your Personal Data. You have the right to object to the processing of your Personal Data if you have serious and legitimate reasons that exceed our need to process your data. You also have the right to object at any time to the use of Personal Data for direct marketing purposes, even without having to give a reason. You have the right to request your Personal Data in digital and readable form and/or to have them transferred to another service provider of your choice. Insofar as our processing is based on your prior consent, you have the right to revoke that consent at any time.

entries.en: Sealed delivery and opened formulas: Awake and Asleep are delivered sealed. The pump is unprimed and the nozzle holds no formula; priming the pump breaks that seal. Once primed, a formula can no longer be sold for hygiene reasons, so the statutory right of withdrawal no longer applies to it (Art. VI.53, 5° WER). Should that exception not apply in your case, we may deduct the loss of value caused by the use from your refund, up to the full price of the formula (Art. VI.51 §2 WER). Our money-back guarantees in clauses 4.2 to 4.4 are more generous and are not affected.

entries.en: Consumable oral care (nature of the goods): under Article 1649quater, §4 of the Belgian Civil Code, the guarantee applies taking into account the nature of the goods. KARMICARE formulas are consumable cosmetic goods designed for an intended cycle of daily use (for example 30 to 60 days, depending on volume and frequency). The guarantee does not mean a formula lasts two years once opened. Normal depletion, natural bristle wear, or use beyond the Period After Opening (PAO) or minimum durability date is not a lack of conformity.

entries.en: The options: Try Once is a single duo without renewal. The 60-Day rhythm delivers one duo and renews every 60 days. The Year delivers six duos, three at the start and three six months later, and renews once a year on its anniversary; a Year that starts on 29 February renews on 28 February. Prices are shown at checkout.

entries.en: Pausing: you can pause for up to 60 days at a time, and for up to 60 days in total within any 12 months. On the Year, a pause postpones your second delivery by up to 60 days; your renewal date stays the same.

entries.en: Cancelling: you can cancel at any time in your customer portal or by email. Cancelling stops your next renewal; it is not a refund request. Deliveries you already paid for, such as the second half of a Year, still arrive. Refunds follow clause 4; for a renewed membership, see 9.9.

entries.en: Renewal orders and ending a renewed Year: renewal orders are dispatched two working days after the charge. If you cancel before dispatch, we refund the renewal in full. Care Credit earned on a refunded amount is removed, or deducted if you already spent it (clause 4.7).
